# Test fixtures

- `overpass-delhi-police-hospital.json`: a real Overpass API response (police stations and hospitals within 2.5 km of central Delhi), trimmed to 14 elements and a subset of tags, recorded 2026-10-10 from `overpass-api.de`. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Used only to test parsing against real-world tag sparsity. Not user data.
